title: The UNI mystery of the Campanile's "World Grand Prize"
summary_en: For decades, a bronze plaque on UNI’s Campanile claimed that the historic tower clock mechanism had won the “World’s Grand Prize” at the 1876 Centennial Exhibition in Philadelphia. There was just one problem… the prize had never existed.
title_cn: The UNI mystery of the Campanile's "World Grand Prize"
